headline: Temporary blip in margins, outlook remains healthy

highlights: Pipe EBITDA/kg dipped 10.3% YoY to INR 31.2 due to adverse product mix and higher RM cost.
India adhesives business revenue grew 25.3% YoY with margin of 10.9% (-610bps YoY) due to RM inflation.
For FY27, management guides for double-digit pipe volume and OPM of ~16–18%; for India adhesive ~20% revenue growth and ~13% OPM.

Pipe volume robust growth of 19.1% YoY on a high base In Q2FY27, Astral reported robust pipe volumes growth of 19.1% YoY on a high base (10- year CAGR of 13.5%; +29.9% QoQ) as demand improved, partly aided by an uptrend in PVC resins prices.
valuation: Valuation and views Astral’s Q2FY27 pipes and consol. revenue (pipes and adhesives) is in line with our estimates, while profitability was lower than our estimates.
We maintain BUY, with a revised SoTP-based Sep’27E target price of INR 1,810.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: Payable days fell as management chose to pay USD-linked suppliers early to avoid currency risk.
The recipient should independently evaluate the investment risks.
